mechanism_narrative: A current decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to lower equity valuations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when RSAFS is declining.

mechanism_narrative: A current INDPRO reading below 100 indicates a contraction in industrial production, signaling economic slowdown and negative equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 but SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and HOUST < 1400 but SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS above 5% during a monetary tightening cycle indicates restrictive policy, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% in tightening cycles but SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Current unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% but SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 units signals weak consumer demand for housing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1400 but SPX 60d returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals weakening demand and inflationary pressures, causing negative equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 365000 and CPIAUCSL > 205 but SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% during a high-unemployment phase indicates labor market stress, reducing consumer spending and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% in high-unemployment phase but SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of cases.
